speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling on your palms. To begin our assessment, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any scaling, blisters, or color changes in the affected areas?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT).

I see a pattern of blistering or fragile skin on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body) combined with sensory neuropathy in a patient with occupational exposure to iron overload risk factors like livestock and potentially arsenic from farming. Has there been any history of liver disease, alcohol use, or family history of similar skin issues?
